evals.prompt: Make an outrun Blender road study with a magenta grid, chrome prop and readable neon cores.
assertions: Uses world-spaced geometry and reflection structure.
Checks grid and neon at delivery pixels.

evals.prompt: Everything is white bloom and the chrome prop is black. Repair without changing the approved palette.
assertions: Reduces halo/exposure rather than replacing colors.

evals.prompt: Create a vaporwave pastel architectural collage with one supplied consumer-era screen and clear depth layers. Do not substitute a dark synthwave road or invent foreign text.
evals.expected_output: Selected collage geometry/material/lighting and clean/treated comparisons.
assertions: The juxtaposition is constructed, not only recolored.
Screen insert and recording treatment remain separate.
Supplied text/branding is preserved and uncertainty is not fabricated.

evals.prompt: An outrun grid shimmers in motion and chrome disappears when bloom is bypassed. Repair projected line coverage and reflection structure, preserving palette.
evals.expected_output: Targeted grid/reflection fixes with glow-off diagnostics and honest motion evidence.
assertions: Checks projected spacing and final-size line coverage.
Adds/repairs reflection environment instead of brightening metal albedo alone.
Motion acceptance requires viewed motion, not a still.
